extraction_notes: The MM3Z10 row was transcribed from the shared electrical-characteristics table; nominal VZ is 10 V at IZT = 5 mA, with VZ min 9.4 V and max 10.6 V.
The zener curve points are digitized readings from the labeled MM3Z10 trace in the p. 3 family plot; no interpolation was added.
The datasheet publishes no numeric capacitance or reverse-recovery-time value for MM3Z10.
Maximum ratings include PD = 200 mW, VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and Tj = -55 to +150 degC.
